text: 31-year-old female. The patient reports experiencing chronic diarrhea on most days for the past four months. She mentions lower abdominal discomfort and cramping, which is relieved by diarrhea. speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. The relief from cramping after a bowel movement and urgency suggest an inflammatory process. To differentiate between Inflammatory Bowel Disease and Infectious Colitis, have you noticed any fever, and did you take any antibiotics recently?
